verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; Meta disruption is confirmed and being fixed.
narrative: This past week, lead volume fell 48% compared to the prior week, driven by Meta ads going completely dark on August 6–7 — two days of zero delivery that collapsed inbound entirely. The 28-day cost per lead of $24.28 remains healthy, but the 7-day cost per lead spiked to roughly $33.40 solely because of those two lost days, not because ad efficiency declined. Meta spend has been restored and daily delivery is being monitored closely to prevent further gaps. You should expect lead volume to normalize back toward the 28-day baseline in the coming week as consistent delivery resumes. One separate pattern worth noting: 80 leads arrived over the last 28 days, but none have entered your active pipeline — we're working with your intake process to close that gap.
